method: Warm or toast the bap while you make the filling. Get the pan properly hot, add the baked beans and let it take on a little colour before you start moving it around.
Give the tomato/veg a minute in the same pan so it picks up the good bits, then add the measured sauce or seasoning and taste it.
Split the bap, build the filling while it is hot and keep the wetter bits in the middle so the bread stays intact.
Press it down, give it 30 seconds to settle, then get stuck in. If you are packing it, cool the filling before wrapping and refrigerate promptly.
